answer: By the bridge of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, forfeited on duplicate submission, rewards vest against future work. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The karst lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the tide is where a second reviewer recomputes them.
